name: FoldScape
description: Generates Q-conditioned ensembles of Cα-only three-dimensional protein conformations from an amino acid sequence at a target fraction of native contacts Q, with optional radius of gyration and secondary-structure conditions, and back-mapping to all-atom coordinates.

attributes.source_locator: description: arXiv abstract and HTML full text: ensembles of Cα conformations conditioned on a target folding fraction Q, directly from sequence; HTML Sections 2.8.2 and 2.9: radius of gyration and secondary-structure fraction are user-specified extra conditions at inference; HTML Section 2.1, stage 7: back-mapping recovers all-atom coordinates from each predicted Cα trace; training_data: arXiv abstract and HTML Sections 2.1, 2.2, 2.3 and 2.4: Section 2.4 steered runs use the OBC2 implicit-solvent model with a relative pulling rate of 2 nm/ns; Section 2.2: Homo sapiens is about 30% of structures retrieved
attributes.training_data: Coarse-grained Gō-model folding simulations and all-atom implicit-solvent steered MD unfolding simulations, seeded from AlphaFold DB structures; approximately one million conformations from 10,000 protein sequences. Homo sapiens accounts for approximately 30% of the AlphaFold DB structures retrieved.
